findings.title: Directive's headline premise is partly mistaken — corrected in PROP-104, flagged here for operator visibility.
findings.detail: Directive states decider's 17M cache_read/run is 'state files re-read each turn'. Verified against decider.md HEAD: the heavy state files (closed-issues.json now 3.1MB — grown from the directive's 1.4MB; open-issues.json; expansion-tracker.json) are ALL read inside bash `node -e` sweep blocks that print only one-line summaries. Their bulk NEVER enters the LLM context window. The 17M cache_read is therefore dominated by the GROWING CONVERSATION PREFIX (system+prompt prose + accumulated verbose tool-result output + 136-158 assistant turns) re-read each turn, NOT by re-reading state files into the LLM. Consequence: a closed-issues precompute (the directive's named target) saves subprocess wall-clock but does NOT by itself cut the headline cache_read. PROP-104 reframes the levers by source: (a) static prompt prose -> prompt-slim; (b) accumulated tool-result output -> trim what bash prints + fewer turns (possibly the biggest lever); (c) genuine in-context state loads -> precompute (the confirmed in-context loads are curmudgeon review bodies in Priority 3, not closed-issues). PROP-104 Phase 0 is explicitly designed to attribute the cache_read empirically and is allowed to KILL Phase 1 if state files prove to contribute ~0.
findings.evidence: decider.md L262/L459/L544/L657/L863 (bash node -e sweeps printing summaries); closed-issues.json=3.1MB; pending-digest.json=560KB (already a precompute via digest-reviews.js).

findings.title: closed-issues.json has more than doubled (1.4MB -> 3.1MB) since the directive was written (~1 day).
findings.detail: Even though it is read in bash (not LLM context), 3.1MB and growing is a wall-clock + subprocess-memory concern for the 5+ full parses decider does per run, and for any agent that DOES load it into context. PROP-104 candidate #3 (closed-issues-recent-90d.json date-windowed slim) addresses the hot-path reads; flagged as low-priority follow-up unless Phase 0 finds an in-context closed-issues print. Worth an independent eye on growth rate.
